repos_data.description: A Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that provides access to NS (Dutch Railways) travel information through Claude AI. This server enables Claude to fetch real-time train travel information and disruptions using the official Dutch NS API.

repo_meta_data.description: MCP server for accessing Dutch World War II archives through the Oorlogsbronnen API. Provides structured access to historical records, photographs, and documents from 1940-1945 Netherlands.
